detect_adsorbate_dissociation: use DetectTrajAnomaly to check if an adsorbate has dissociated during a relaxation trajectory
detect_surface_reconstruction: use DetectTrajAnomaly to test if the surface has changed due to bond breaking or forming events
detect_adsorbate_desorption: use DetectTrajAnomaly to check if an adsorbate has desorbed from the slab surface
detect_adsorbate_intercalation: use DetectTrajAnomaly to check if an adsorbate is interacting with frozen bulk atoms
build_connectivity_matrix: use DetectTrajAnomaly to generate a connectivity matrix for an ASE Atoms object
